title: Remove and replace a Limit/Home sensor (A-axis or Z-axis) with LOTO
summary: Perform LOTO on the OptiSweep tipper, unplug the defective Limit/Home proximity sensor, and remove it from its mounting location. A-axis sensors are unplugged from a PCA near the A-axis motor; Z-axis sensors are unplugged from the CLINK controller inside the control box.
when_to_use: Use when a Limit/Home proximity sensor (A-axis or Z-axis) is defective and must be unplugged and physically removed for replacement.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: perform LOTO on the tipper and carry out the physical unplug/removal steps for the defective Limit/Home sensor.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before unplugging or removing the sensor.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper for LOTO
Replacement part: Limit sensor or home sensor

access_required: Physical access to the tipper for LOTO
system_preconditions: Tipper is LOTO’d before unplugging/removing the sensor.

visual_references.description: Controller PCA diagram showing the controller box and access context for controller-related components (used for visual orientation of the control box area).
CLINK controller diagram showing controller box access and cable connections (used for Z-axis sensor location context).
A-axis PCA connections diagram showing where A-axis sensor wiring plugs into the PCA after routing through the wire routing hole.

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely locked out/tagged out before unplugging the sensor.
steps.instruction: Apply Operator Station Lockout/Tagout to the tipper (LOTO the tipper).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in a locked-out/tagged-out state prior to sensor unplugging/removal.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is completed and the tipper is secured such that sensor unplugging/removal can be performed safely.
steps.failure_condition: LOTO cannot be completed or the tipper lockout/tagout controls are not accessible/clear.

actions.label: LOTO the tipper
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if LOTO cannot be completed or the tipper lockout/tagout controls are not accessible/clear.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 7.3.2.1.1 REMOVAL: LOTO the tipper; Unplug the sensor;

steps.title: Unplug the sensor
steps.purpose: Disconnect the defective Limit/Home proximity sensor electrically before physical removal.
steps.expected_result: The defective sensor is electrically disconnected (unplugged) from its connection point.
steps.healthy_condition: Sensor unplugging is straightforward and does not require forcing or damaging nearby wiring/connectors.
steps.failure_condition: The sensor cannot be unplugged without forcing (risk of damaging PCA/CLINK controller wiring).
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the sensor cannot be unplugged without forcing (risk of damaging the PCA/CLINK controller wiring or the wire routing).

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: 7.3.2.1.1 REMOVAL: LOTO the tipper; Unplug the sensor;

steps.title: Identify sensor type by location (A-axis vs Z-axis)
steps.purpose: Use the correct physical removal method based on where the sensor is mounted and connected.
steps.instruction: Identify whether the defective sensor is an A-axis sensor or a Z-axis sensor by its location and connection type.
steps.expected_result: You correctly determine the sensor location: A-axis sensors are plugged into a PCA near the A-axis motor; Z-axis sensors are plugged into the CLINK controller inside the control box.
steps.healthy_condition: A-axis sensor is recognized as PCA-near-A-axis-motor connection; Z-axis sensor is recognized as CLINK-controller-inside-control-box connection.
steps.failure_condition: Sensor location/type cannot be confidently identified, leading to incorrect removal approach.

actions.label: Identify by location
actions.exact_action: A-axis sensors are plugged into a printed circuit assembly (PCA) near the A-axis motor; Z-axis sensors are plugged into the CLINK controller inside the control box.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: A-axis sensors are plugged into a printed circuit assembly (PCA) near the A-axis motor; Z-axis sensors are plugged into the CLINK controller inside the control box.

steps.title: Remove the mounting screw and feed the sensor through the wire routing hole
steps.purpose: Physically detach the sensor from its mounting location and free it from the routed wiring path.
steps.instruction: Remove the M3 button-head screw holding the sensor in place and feed the sensor through the hole where the wire is routed.
steps.expected_result: The sensor is unfastened (M3 button-head screw removed) and can be fed through the wire routing hole.
steps.healthy_condition: Sensor removal proceeds without forcing; the wire routing hole allows the sensor to pass cleanly.
steps.failure_condition: Forcing is required to remove the sensor, risking damage to PCA/CLINK controller wiring or wire routing.

actions.label: Remove M3 screw
actions.exact_action: Remove the M3 button-head screw holding the sensor in place and feed the sensor through the hole where the wire is routed.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the sensor cannot be unplugged or removed without forcing (risk of damaging the PCA/CLINK controller wiring or the wire routing).

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Remove the M3 button-head screw holding the sensor in place and feed it through the hole where the wire is routed.

steps.title: For Z-axis sensors: pull the sensor from the column
steps.purpose: Complete physical removal for Z-axis sensor assemblies.
steps.instruction: If the sensor is Z-axis, pull the Z-axis sensor from the column.
steps.expected_result: The Z-axis sensor is fully removed from the column.
steps.healthy_condition: The sensor pulls free without resistance that would require forcing.
steps.failure_condition: The sensor cannot be pulled free without forcing (risk of damaging wiring or mounting).

actions.label: Pull Z-axis sensor
actions.exact_action: Pull the Z-axis sensor from the column.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the sensor cannot be unplugged or removed without forcing (risk of damaging the PCA/CLINK controller wiring or the wire routing).

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Pull the Z-axis sensor from the column.

steps.title: For A-axis sensors: pull the sensor away; cut wire tie if needed
steps.purpose: Complete physical removal for A-axis sensor assemblies, including freeing it from any wire tie restraint.
steps.instruction: If the sensor is A-axis, pull the defective A-axis sensor away. If needed, cut the wire tie to free the sensor.
steps.expected_result: The A-axis sensor is removed from its mounting location; any wire tie that blocks removal is cut if required.
steps.healthy_condition: Sensor removal is achieved without damaging the PCA wiring; wire tie is cut only if it prevents removal.
steps.failure_condition: Forcing is required to free the sensor, or cutting is not performed when a wire tie blocks removal.

actions.label: Pull A-axis sensor
actions.exact_action: For A-axis sensors: pull the defective A-axis sensor away; if needed, cut the wire tie to free the sensor.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the sensor cannot be unplugged or removed without forcing (risk of damaging the PCA/CLINK controller wiring or the wire routing).

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: defective A-axis sensor is pulled away, but the wire tie may need to be cut.

success_criteria: Defective Limit/Home sensor is physically removed from its mounting location.

failure_conditions: Sensor cannot be unplugged or removed without forcing (risk of damaging PCA/CLINK controller wiring or wire routing).
LOTO cannot be completed or tipper lockout/tagout controls are not accessible/clear.
